claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, PP-2 is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since it is a Src-family kinase inhibitor whose cellular effects (e.g., inhibition of FAK phosphorylation) are typically observed at 1-10 uM without producing broad cell killing.
